pairs.difference: A has a straight, flat mouthpiece with tight corners and a clearly open attachment ring. B rounds the mouthpiece into a swollen taper and compresses the ring's opening against the body.
pairs.fix: Draw a flat-sided rectangular mouthpiece with small corner bevels; leave a clear open gap inside the thin metal attachment ring.

pairs.difference: A has one broad tubing loop beneath the horn and substantial hanging tassels. B adds a second narrow loop on the right, while its tassels shrink relative to the long horn.
pairs.fix: Use one continuous oval tubing loop beneath the horn. Enlarge the two hanging tassels relative to the instrument.

pairs.difference: Both cups have tapered bowls, thin rims, open handles and shallow saucers. B has a smaller handle opening and less pronounced foot, but neither shows a convincing distortion of form.
A has thicker basket strands and a broader handle; B has narrower weaving and a slimmer handle. Both preserve an open handle arch and a plausible tapered basket body.
Both barrels have bowed staves, narrower ends and four distinct metal hoops. Hoop spacing and the visible top opening differ, but neither has a clear proportion fault.
A separates the hood, fenders and projecting bumper into distinct forms. B merges the hood and front fenders into a fuller rounded mass and reduces the bumper to a thick smooth strip.
pairs.fix: Give the hood and front fenders distinct contours. Draw a projecting metal bumper with defined ends and smaller bevels.

pairs.difference: A has taut roof panels, straight lower edges and narrow secured entrance flaps. B has deeply bowed roof edges and thick rolled entrance flaps that make the tent look soft and inflated.
pairs.fix: Draw taut fabric panels stretched between the ridge and straight ground edges. Keep the entrance flaps thin, folded back and secured with narrow ties.

pairs.difference: A has a deep pot with relatively straight upper sides, a broad mouth and slender upright supports. B makes the pot nearly spherical beneath a smaller mouth and thickens the angled support poles.
pairs.fix: Draw a deep cooking pot with straighter upper walls and a broad opening. Use slender upright wooden supports and a thin arched metal handle.

pattern: Generated cards tend to soften corners, inflate surfaces and thicken thin parts, weakening the object's characteristic proportions and negative gaps.
